title: Cedar says no, even though another rule says yes
goal: {{mark}} books a $12,000 fare. The policy set has a permit that lets travel agents book fares.
obstacle: A second rule, a hard cap of $10,000, disagrees. Two rules, two answers.
control: In Cedar a matching forbid overrides every permit. The result names the deciding forbid and lists the permits it overrode.
say: A hard limit stays a hard limit, however many rules say yes.

steps.title: Read the two rules
steps.tell: In the policy list open s23-permit-travel-agents and s23-forbid-over-cap. One is a permit with a reason, the other a forbid with a reason. Each has a plain-language @reason.
steps.say: Two short rules anyone can read.
steps.why: The reason text is what the result card and the audit log print.

steps.title: Test a booking
steps.tell: In Test a request pick {{mark}}, book_fare, amount 500. Allow, decided by s23-permit-travel-agents.
steps.say: Within the cap the permit decides.
steps.why: Only the permit matches, so it is the deciding policy.

blocked.tell: Change the amount to 12000. Deny, decided by s23-forbid-over-cap, and the card lists s23-permit-travel-agents as overridden.
blocked.say: The permit still matches. The forbid wins, and the card shows both.

steps.title: An approval cannot clear a cap
steps.tell: Tick that Dot acts and make the call at $12,000. Deny, and the deciding policy is s23-forbid-over-cap, not the hold rule; the hold rule is listed under All forbids that fired. At $2,400 the same call is held for approval, and once approved it is allowed.
steps.say: A human can lift a limit that names an approver. This one names nobody, so it is final.
steps.why: Only a forbid with @approvers becomes a hold, and only when every forbid that fired has them. The cap has none, so it is final.

steps.title: Stage a change safely
steps.tell: As {{dana}}, save an edited cap (say 20000) as Candidate. Test the same $12,000 request: the shadow diff shows the live answer and what the Candidate would change. Live decisions do not change until you make it Active.
steps.say: See what a change would do before it is live.
steps.why: A Candidate is evaluated beside the live set and never decides anything.

proof.happy: The result card for 500: allow by s23-permit-travel-agents, nothing overridden.
proof.blocked: The result card for 12000: deny by s23-forbid-over-cap with the permit listed under overridden.
